article.story: SPARTANBURG, S.C. -- — Kahmare Holmes scored 21 points as Wofford beat North Florida 86-78 on Wednesday. Holmes had nine rebounds and three steals for the Terriers (3-2). Chace Watley scored 16 points, shooting 7 of 8 from the field. Nils Machowski shot 3 for 12 and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 11 points. Kamrin Oriol led the way for the Ospreys (1-3) with 22 points. BJ Plummer added 16 points and Mason Lee also had 13. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
